company.name: Palomma
company.shortDescription: Palomma helps merchants in the community save money on card fees by allowing customers to pay directly from their bank.
company.description: Palomma is a tech company that saves merchants in the community money on card fees by allowing customers to pay directly from their bank at checkout. It enables users to make secure payments with their bank account with a single click and earn rewards in affiliated businesses. With secure, one-click bank payments, merchants can reduce processing costs while increasing conversion.

productsAndServices.description: An API service enabling secure online payments for merchants, allowing users to pay via credit/debit cards, bank accounts, and other methods.
productsAndServices.name: Palomma Payments API

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables merchants to collect payments from users through WhatsApp messaging without leaving the app.
productsAndServices.name: Bill Collection and Payment via WhatsApp

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows merchants to disperse funds to users through Palomma acting as their representative.
productsAndServices.name: Funds Dispersion Service

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows users to register automatic debits for recurring payments to merchants.
productsAndServices.name: Automatic Debit Service

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,100,000, or 68.75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,562,510 to $10,880,866, a 1.66x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 86 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 72 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include dLocal, EBANX, PayU GPO.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
